primary_path_value: Compare the two measurement histories with the same joint replay estimator, same 60 s truth, and acquisition/availability times preserved.
secondary: Repeat comparison holding the fixed replay estimator constant; report post-startup MSE separately.
identical_readings: Compare physical reading fields with times on the declared integer clock, excluding bookkeeping IDs; if identical, reuse verified own-method replay scores and record the equality explicitly.
notes: No shadow estimator controls the scanner. This separates the value of different measurements from an estimator's better interpretation of the same measurements. Smaller regions or fewer readings alone are not success.
